title: Sage ui_layout record
description: A ui_layout record (UiLayoutRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another ui_layout record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

style.description: The style of every node that names none and has no ancestor that does. Names a ui_style record. (RecordRef<UiStyleRecord>)

nodes.description: The widgets, by name: each has a widget type and names its parent (none: the layout's root) (Dictionary<string, UiNode>)

widget.description: What it is: box, stack, grid, label, image, button, item_list, bar, scroll, slider, checkbox, dropdown, text_field, tabs or view. (string)

parent.description: The node it is inside, by name; empty: the layout's root. (string)

order.description: Among its siblings, lower first; equal ones keep the order they are written in. (int)

style.description: Its style; empty: its parent's. Names a ui_style record. (RecordRef<UiStyleRecord>)

text.description: A label's, button's or checkbox's text, or what a text field starts with; '@ns.key' is a localisation key. (string)

args.description: Values for the text's {placeholders}, by name: each a path into the view-model ({count} also picks the plural form) (Dictionary<string, string>)

tooltip.description: What its tooltip says; '@ns.key' is a localisation key. (string)

source.description: An image's picture. A texture path. (AssetPath)

icon.description: A button's picture, drawn across it under its text (an item over its squares) A texture path. (AssetPath)

naturalSize.description: An image's size when nothing stretches it. Unit: units. (Vector2)

keepAspect.description: An image keeps its proportions (default true) (bool?)

target.description: A view's picture: the render target it shows, by name (a camera's `target`, or its own camera's) (string)

camera.description: A view's own camera, drawing its target: an orbit round the player (a paper doll) or a top-down map; none: a camera entity draws the target. (UiViewCameraNode)

mode.description: Orbit: round its subject, looking at it from in front; TopDown: straight down on it, north up, a map. (ViewCamera)

subject.description: What it looks at: 'player' (the screen's subject or the local player), 'other' (the NPC talked to, the corpse looted) or an entity by name; empty: centre. (string)

centre.description: Where it looks with no subject (a fixed map) Unit: m. (Vector3)

distance.description: Orbit: how far from the point it looks at. Unit: m. At least 0.01. (float)

height.description: Orbit: how far above the subject's origin the point it looks at is. Unit: m. (float)

yaw.description: Orbit: degrees round the subject from in front of it; TopDown: the map turned. Unit: deg. Range: -360 to 360. (float)

pitch.description: Orbit: degrees above the subject, looking down on it. Unit: deg. Range: -89 to 89. (float)

spin.description: Turns by itself this fast (a turntable); 0: still. Unit: deg/s. (float)

fieldOfView.description: Orbit: the vertical field of view. Unit: deg. Range: 1 to 170. (float)

radius.description: TopDown: metres from the middle of the map to its edges. Unit: m. At least 0.01. (float)

altitude.description: TopDown: how far above the point it looks at. Unit: m. At least 1. (float)

far.description: The far clip plane. Unit: m. At least 1. (float)

resolution.description: The target's pixels across its longer side; 0: as many as the view covers on screen. Unit: px. Range: 0 to 4096. (int)

rotatable.description: The player turns it, dragging across it or with Left and Right while it has focus. (bool)

sky.description: Draws the sky behind (default: the clear colour) (bool)

shadows.description: Casts shadows in it (default: none, no second shadow map) (bool)

fogColour.description: What an image's or view's bound `fog` covers the unrevealed part of the picture with; empty: near-black. (uint?)

textScale.description: Text size, 1 = the font's; empty: its style's. (float?)

textAlign.description: Where text sits in a bigger label: Start, Center, End. (Align?)

wrap.description: A label's text breaks at spaces to fit its width (and maxWidth): a paragraph. (bool)

overflow.description: What a label's text that still does not fit does: Visible (runs past), Clip, Ellipsis (ends in '…') (TextOverflow?)

maxWidth.description: A label is never wider than this; 0: no limit but its room. Unit: units. At least 0. (float)

minSize.description: Never smaller than this. Unit: units. (Vector2)

margin.description: Space around it: 4, [h, v] or [left, top, right, bottom]. (Thickness)

padding.description: Space inside it; empty: its style's. (Thickness?)

anyOf.description: Space on each side, in virtual units: 4 (all), [h, v] or [left, top, right, bottom].

hAlign.description: How it sits across its slot in a stack, grid or scroll: Fill, Start, Center, End. (Align?)

vAlign.description: How it sits down its slot: Fill, Start, Center, End. (Align?)

expand.description: In a stack, its share of the room left over. At least 0. (float)

columnSpan.description: In a grid, how many cells across it takes; 0 or 1: one. Range: 0 to 64. (int)

rowSpan.description: In a grid, how many cells down it takes; 0 or 1: one. Range: 0 to 64. (int)

anchors.description: In a box: a name (top_left, center, bottom_right, fill, top_wide...) or [minX, minY, maxX, maxY]. (Anchors?)

anyOf.description: Where a box places it: a preset, or [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] as fractions of the box (equal: keep its size; different: stretch).

direction.description: A stack's or bar's direction: Row or Column. (Orientation?)

spacing.description: Between a stack's children, or a grid's cells. Unit: units. At least 0. (float)

columns.description: A grid's cells to a row (default 1) At least 0. (int)

uniform.description: A grid's cells are all the size of the biggest. (bool)

step.description: A slider's step: the values it snaps to from min, and what a press moves it; empty: a twentieth of the range, unsnapped. At least 0. (float?)

options.description: A dropdown's options, in order; '@ns.key' is a localisation key. (List<string>)

options+.description: Adds to "options": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

options-.description: Removes these from "options" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

selected.description: The dropdown option or tab shown at first, from 0. At least -1. (int?)

placeholder.description: What an empty text field shows, faded; '@ns.key' is a localisation key. (string)

maxLength.description: The most characters a text field takes; 0: 256. At least 0. (int)

multiline.description: A text field takes Enter as a new line. (bool)

title.description: Its tab's title, when it is a page of tabs; '@ns.key' is a localisation key. (string)

tabStyle.description: The style of a tabs' tab buttons; the open one is drawn in its `selected` state. Names a ui_style record. (RecordRef<UiStyleRecord>)

visible.description: Hidden, it takes no room (default true) (bool)

enabled.description: Disabled, it cannot be focused or pressed (default true) (bool)

focusable.description: Takes focus; buttons and list items do by default. (bool?)

draggable.description: The pointer can drag it and drop it on something else; a click on it then activates on release. (bool)

tabIndex.description: Tab order: lower first, then tree order. (int)

focusScope.description: Traps focus while it shows: the D-pad, Tab and the pointer reach nothing outside it, and focus goes back where it was when it hides (a confirm prompt) (bool)

focusUp.description: The node Up goes to from here, by name; empty: the nearest one above. (string)

focusDown.description: The node Down goes to from here, by name; empty: the nearest one below. (string)

focusLeft.description: The node Left goes to from here, by name; empty: the nearest one to the left. (string)

focusRight.description: The node Right goes to from here, by name; empty: the nearest one to the right. (string)

visibleIf.description: Shown only while this holds, asked about the screen's subject: { "var": "alarm", "eq": 1 }. (ICondition)

actions.description: Done when it is pressed, before the view-model hears of it: actions by name, with the screen's subject and other ({ "open_screen": "rpg:shop" }, { "close_screen": {} }) (List<IAction>)

actions+.description: Adds to "actions": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

actions-.description: Removes these from "actions" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

bind.description: A path into the view-model for its main value: a label's text, a bar's value, an image's source, a list's rows; a slider's value, a checkbox's checked, a dropdown's or tabs' selected and a text field's text, which the player's changes are written back to. (string)

bindings.description: Paths for other properties, by property: text, value, min, max, source, tooltip, style, visible, enabled, rows, checked, selected, options; icon, iconTurned, columnSpan, rowSpan; an image's or view's fog, a view's target and radius. (Dictionary<string, string>)
